# Categorical variable transformation
```{python include=FALSE}
import pandas as pd
import biogeme
import biogeme.version as ver

# Load Data
file_path = r"C:\Users\ohdaw\OneDrive - Harvard University\tu_data\data_reduced_hh.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)
```

# Formatting variable
```{python echo=FALSE}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Assuming you already have a dataframe called 'data'

# List of variables to plot
variables = ["PrimMode", "primode_cat", "JStartTimeMsm", "JEndTimeMsm", "TravelTimeMinutes", "SumMin", "SumLen", "ActivityTime", "TransportDistance", "PrimTargetPurp", "PrimTargetPurp_Cat", "FamNumPers", "FamNumAdults", "HousehNumPers", "HousehNumAdults", "HousehNumPersO6", "FamNumPersO6", "NumChld", "PartyNumu10", "PartyNum1017", "Chldu6", "maxchldu10", "PosInFamily", "SingleAdult", "MultiAdult", "OlderInCouple", "YoungerInCouple", "IsMan", "IsWoman", "RespSex", "RespAgeSimple", "RespPrimOcc", "IsWorker", "IsNonWorker", "JourneyComplx"]
             
# Set plot style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Loop through each variable and create a histogram or countplot
for var in variables:
    plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4))
    
    if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(data[var]):
        sns.histplot(data[var].dropna(), kde=False, bins=20)
        plt.ylabel("Count")
    else:
        sns.countplot(x=var, data=data)
        plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')
    
    plt.title(f'Distribution of {var}')
    plt.xlabel(var)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```

# Formating for parameters
```{python, include=FALSE}
# One-hot encode JourneyWithChildren (0/1 format)
data = pd.get_dummies(data, columns=["JourneyWithChildren"], prefix="JWC")

# Check transformed dataset
print(data.head())
```

# Convert categorical variables
```{python include=FALSE}
# Convert categorical variables to integer codes
categorical_columns = ["primode_cat", "PrimTargetPurp_Cat", "PosInFamily", "SingleAdult", "MultiAdult", "OlderInCouple", "YoungerInCouple", "IsMan", "IsWoman", "RespSex",  "RespPrimOcc", "IsWorker", "IsNonWorker", "JourneyComplx"]

data = pd.get_dummies(data, columns=categorical_columns, drop_first=False)

# Convert boolean columns to integers (if applicable)
bool_columns = ["JWC_0", "JWC_1", "JWC_2"]
data[bool_columns] = data[bool_columns].astype(int)

# Drop rows with missing values (or impute them if needed)
data = data.dropna() 
```

# Import database
```{python include=FALSE}
import biogeme.database as db
import biogeme.biogeme as bio
from biogeme import models
from biogeme.expressions import Beta
from biogeme . expressions import Variable

# Convert to numeric, forcing non-numeric values to NaN
data['AgeOldChld'] = pd.to_numeric(data['AgeOldChld'], errors='coerce')
data['AgeOldChld'] = data['AgeOldChld'].fillna(0)

# Load data into Biogeme database
data = data.astype({col: 'int' for col in data.select_dtypes('bool').columns})
database = db.Database("JourneyChoice_1", data)
```

# log transforming
```{python echo=FALSE}
import numpy as np

data["TTM_scaled"] = np.log(data["TravelTimeMinutes"])

plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4))
sns.histplot(data["TTM_scaled"], bins=30, kde=True, color='skyblue')
plt.xlabel("Log of TravelTimeMinutes")
plt.ylabel("Frequency")
plt.title("Histogram of Log-Transformed TravelTimeMinutes")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

# Caegorical transforming
```{python echo=FALSE}
database = db.Database("JourneyChoice_1", data)
TravelTimeMinutes = Variable('TravelTimeMinutes')

# Define travel time bins as dummy variables
data['TTM_cat_0_60']    = ((data['TravelTimeMinutes'] >= 0) & (data['TravelTimeMinutes'] < 60)).astype(int)
data['TTM_cat_60_120']  = ((data['TravelTimeMinutes'] >= 60) & (data['TravelTimeMinutes'] < 120)).astype(int)
data['TTM_cat_120_180'] = ((data['TravelTimeMinutes'] >= 120) & (data['TravelTimeMinutes'] < 180)).astype(int)

data['TTM_cat_660_720'] = ((data['TravelTimeMinutes'] >= 660) & (data['TravelTimeMinutes'] < 720)).astype(int)

TTM_cat_0_60    = Variable("TTM_cat_0_60")
```
